_comment: busy-worker-stop-check.py の「文脈圧縮の要約の続きを本人の発言に数えない」 と「本人が親の窓で子を畳んでよいと言った後は、 子の待ちの中でも archive を 1 回目から通す」 の foil の歯 (修正の一部を外した mutant で、 その部分を見る check だけが落ちるか)。

mutants.name: 要約の印 (isCompactSummary) を見ない
pairs:
if e.get("type") != "user" or e.get("isMeta") or e.get("isCompactSummary"):
    if e.get("type") != "user" or e.get("isMeta"):
expect_fail: a compaction summary (isCompactSummary) is not the person's prompt
expect_pass: the compaction continuation text without the flag

mutants.name: 印の無い要約の続きの文を本人の発言から外さない
pairs: "This session is being continued from a previous conversation",
expect_fail: the compaction continuation text without the flag
expect_pass: a compaction summary (isCompactSummary) is not the person's prompt

mutants.name: 本人の「閉じていい」 を読まない (直す前の判定)
pairs:
if consent_after(inp.get("transcript_path") or "", hold.get("since") or ""):
    if False:
expect_fail: scene, the old 30-minute grace: 「閉じていいよ」
expect_pass: a negated or asked word (閉じていい？)

mutants.name: 子の理由が始まる前の言葉も数える
pairs: hits = [ts for ts, t in human_prompts(path) if ts[:19] > since[:19] and close_consent(t)]
hits = [ts for ts, t in human_prompts(path) if close_consent(t)]
expect_fail: 「閉じていいよ」 before the person's last prompt in the child's window
archive of an idle child the person is still talking with
expect_pass: a negated or asked word (閉じていい？)

mutants.name: 打ち消し・問いの形も同意と読む
expect_fail: a negated or asked word (閉じていい？)
a negated or asked word (don't archive it)
expect_pass: close_consent: the words that say fold

mutants.name: turn の途中の子の archive に stop と同じ「本人に聞く」 の文を出す (直す前の判定)
expect_fail: archive of a session mid-turn → blocked with 'wait for the turn end', not 'ask the person'
... the person's word after it does not pass a mid-turn archive (the turn end does)
expect_pass: desktop stop_session on a busy session → blocked
close_consent: 「閉じて良し」 is a fold word (the word in the measured scene)

mutants.name: 本人とのやりとりの理由が無い子の wrap の記録を見ない (直す前の判定)
pairs:
if not reasons:
        return wrap_check(inp, ids, cw)
expect_fail: R6: own child, no wrap after the parent's last message → blocked once
expect_pass: R6: own child that ran the wrap after the parent's last message → passes

mutants.name: 本人の「畳んで」 で wrap の無い子も通す (直す前の判定)
pairs: return wrap_check(inp, ids, cw)  # the person's word covers the person's side, not a missing wrap
expect_fail: R6: the person's 「畳んで」 passes the person's side, then the missing wrap stops it once
expect_pass: R6: own child, no wrap after the parent's last message → blocked once

mutants.name: 本人の苦情・問いの文も「wrap なしで」 の言葉と読む (直す前の判定)
expect_pass: no_wrap_said: the words that skip the wrap
